why: Each row has three shapes made of a straight line and two half-circles: an S-like shape, a d-like shape and a B shape. Each row also has one black top, one hatched top and one empty top. Row 3 has the B (empty) and the S (hatched), so the missing figure is the d shape with a black top. That is option 4. Option 2 is the right shape but its top is empty.
trick: In a 3x3 grid, each shape and each shading usually appears once in every row; find the pair still missing.
note: Options 1, 3 and 4 have a dotted dark shading in the scan; drawn as solid black like the black tops in the grid.
